name: Honda MT125 / MT250 Elsinore
engine: 123 or 248 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, oil injection
intro: Street-legal enduros based on the Elsinore motocrossers. Lights and oil injection.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
